purpose: Teach: 年度末/社債/付け加える/構える/済ませる/終日/折っ/心がける

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 年度末、ご苦労様、皆さん、お疲れでしょう。
lines.en: Everyone, we're in the final stretch of the fiscal year. Thank you for your hard work.
lines.style: Warm, acknowledging tone. Opens with quiet authority but genuine appreciation underneath. Measured pace, like someone who means what she says.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社債格付け、安定維持してます。
lines.en: Yes. We've maintained stable corporate bond ratings.
lines.style: Straightforward, professional. Quick efficiency without rushing. Respectful report-back to a superior who has earned that respect.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 報告書に、市場分析を付け加える方向で。
lines.en: I'd like you to add market analysis to the report.
lines.style: Clear directive, but not sharp. A request phrased as direction. Even pace, matter-of-fact but open to questions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。来期は、しっかり構える体制で。
lines.en: Understood. We'll be ready with a solid framework for next quarter.
lines.style: Assured and capable. Light nod in the voice. Steady delivery that signals readiness without boasting.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 急ぎの案件、今日中に、済ませるよう。
lines.en: I need the urgent items completed by end of day.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. A clear priority marker. Slight lean on 'today' to signal the deadline matters, but measured, not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理は、終日、対応可能です。
lines.en: Yes. Accounting can stay on top of it all day if needed.
lines.style: Reassuring capacity. Calm, professional certainty. The tone of someone who has already thought through the logistics.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 紙、折って、封筒にしまうよう、お願い。
lines.en: And please make sure all the documents are folded and filed in the envelopes.
lines.style: Polite but precise instruction. Conversational warmth wrapped around a practical task. Slight lift at the end, acknowledging the small detail matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コスト削減、心がけるよう、徹底しています。
lines.en: Of course. We're keeping cost reduction in mind across the board.
lines.style: Assured follow-through. A quiet pledge beneath the simple affirmation. Steady, thoughtful delivery that shows this principle is already embedded in the work.
